unresolved_gaps: No located evaluation establishes the April 13 model's success rate for low-expertise users attempting realistic power-grid disruption.
The AISI tests do not establish an upper bound on capability against defended infrastructure.
The relationship between the checkpoint evaluated in the April 13 report and subsequently evaluated checkpoints remains insufficiently established for retrospective scoring.
Marcus supplies neither a quantitative meaning for the claimed large gap nor an identifiable set of other portrayals.
